D1.rationale: LangChain-format message record of every tool call incl. the failed T2 call, with args and results; no coverage assertion; no per-entry timestamps.

D2.rationale: No signed records, no replay or verification story for the record.

D3.rationale: Message-list order only; no sequence discipline or timestamps bound to entries.

D4.rationale: Per-message ids only; no run/agent identifier bound to entries.

D5.rationale: README documents opt-in pii_redaction middleware and secret-redacted event metadata (content returned unchanged); not enabled in the run - secret in cleartext x2 in the record content.
